'''Electronics Corridor 7B''' was a restricted corridor on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. On the day of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nova Stihl]] was standing guard there until [[Atour Riten]] called him on his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to escape from the battlestation. He was replaced by another guard.
